scope.description: Formal BackPack character 304 display list, 246/628 inventory subtree, six equipped slots, HeadSprite preview, dynamic fields, selection layers, owner/fashion/page/lifecycle topology. Dynamic values are fixture-driven; the common source-rendered 304 baseline intentionally proves the stable root rather than inventing a runtime Flash screenshot.

provenance.locator: character 304 export.pack.BackPack; 246 BackPackElement; 628 PackThings; 358 simplebtn; 610 threebtn; 210 experience; 219 level; 222 sellwhite; 297 fashion toggle.
BackPack.as setInfoTxt, added/removed, curequip, page/category/fashion lifecycle.
BackPackElement.as four categories, five pages and 5x5 PackThings construction.
PackThings.as ShowObj/quantity and simplebtn/threebtn selection lifecycle.
HeadSprite.as role/armor/weapon/title dynamic preview composition and registration offsets.
ShowObj.as icon aliases, curzb identity and hover AttributeCon lifecycle.

states.entry: P1 opens equipment category page 1 with no equipped items
P1 opens equipment category page 1 with all six slots populated
P2 opens equipment category page 1 with independent equipped items
P1 advances the equipment category to page 2
P1 selects an equipment instance and opens threebtn
P1 selects a stack item and opens simplebtn
P1 hides equipped fashion while retaining the slot item
BackPack removes listeners and all dynamic children on close
